extracted.intended_audience: PR/communications professionals and clients submitting Multichannel News Releases via MultiVu / PR Newswire
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting all assets (text, images, video, translations, branding) and meeting technical/content requirements for a PR Newswire Multichannel News Release (MNR).

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum assets to commence order
rubrics_metrics.description: Your Multichannel News Release order can commence as soon as three of the components and assets listed below have been submitted to the Multichannel News Release team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure at least three required components/assets are submitted before expecting work to start; upon receipt PR Newswire will be in touch with turn-around times.

rubrics_metrics.name: Working hours and communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The core working hours for Multichannel News Releases are 08:00 to 17:30 GMT, Monday to Friday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Turn-around times and project commencement communications will be provided after receipt of a client's order. Contact via provided email or phone for queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: File delivery methods
rubrics_metrics.description: When sending us your Multichannel News Release assets, please use one of the following file sharing services, WeTransfer, Dropbox etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard file‑sharing services to deliver large multimedia assets rather than email attachments to ensure timely receipt and processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Branding and layout provisioning
rubrics_metrics.description: Fully branded Multichannel News Releases need help from you, the client. Any branding ideas, guidelines, colours or images supplied upfront are a big help in getting your Multichannel News Release started.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide brand guidelines, preferred colours, logos and example imagery up front if you want a fully branded MNR. Review provided examples for layout inspiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design option selection
rubrics_metrics.description: We have five design options available, below are some previous examples. HERO, SHOWCASE, HERO SIDE BAR, HERO INLINE, HERO LITE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a design option early as image placement and page layout vary by design; review sample MNRs to decide which design best fits your assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video length recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure your video is less than 5 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shorter videos focus the message, reduce page-load times, and are easier for viewers to digest. Keep to under five minutes for best pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video language recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: That your video is in English, PR Newswire can offer distribution in multiple languages (English subtitles recommended); however, most of our portals are global.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: English language videos will maximise pickup across global portals. If using other languages, consider supplying English subtitles to improve distribution and reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image metadata requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Images should have a title, caption and file name to allow for optimum engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a title (max 100 characters, including spaces) and a caption (max 250 characters, including spaces) for each image, and ensure filenames are meaningful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image technical specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: We recommend your photos to be 2700 pixels on the longest side and 300 dpi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-resolution images (≈2700px longest side, 300 dpi) are recommended to ensure quality across formats and placements. Supply captions with each image.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted image file formats
rubrics_metrics.description: These are the following formats that we will accept: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, GIF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit images in one of the accepted formats to avoid processing delays or conversion issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release text role and content guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: This text portion of your Multichannel News Release will be the same that goes out to all of your desired distribution points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After the first paragraph of your release there will be a link to your Multichannel News Release page. The idea, the sale, the product or your message should be accurately and concisely conveyed. PR Newswire's editorial service can provide proofreading and editorial suggestions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations and language toggle
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire's distribution service is a truly global platform. Translations can take up to 48 hours to complete. Clients are encouraged to supply their own translations for their Multichannel News Release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may supply translations to speed publication; PR Newswire can translate (allow up to 48 hours). A language toggle can be added to display alternate languages (offered in 23 languages); additional charges apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive reporting (Visibility Reports)
rubrics_metrics.description: The reporting for your campaign is available 24/7 within our online reporting platform - Visibility Reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect robust data (full distribution and specific page interactions), enhanced visuals (dynamic graphics and mouse-over charts), export and sharing features (download graphs), and easy access via alert emails or logging in to your Visibility Reports account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead generation form availability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MNRs can include lead generation functionality—discuss options with the MNR team when ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacts for support and ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have any queries please do not hesitate to get in touch: [email protected] or call us: +44 (0)207 454 5111. EMEA & India MNR Team: [email protected] +44 (0) 207 454 5111.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided contacts for questions about asset requirements, turnaround times, translations, reporting and other service details.
